# Precision Remodel LLC

> Precision Remodel LLC is a licensed Maryland home improvement contractor (MHIC #151439) that builds high-end kitchens and bathrooms, and handles foundation and structural repairs, for homeowners in Northeast Baltimore County, MD. Owner Jonathan Kruse is also a licensed Maryland home inspector. Kitchens start at $25,000 and bathrooms at $16,000; every project is fixed-price with a written proposal.

- Service area: Northeast Baltimore County only (Essex, Middle River, White Marsh, Perry Hall, Nottingham, Parkville, Overlea, Towson, Lutherville, Timonium, Cockeysville, Hunt Valley).
- Process: free in-home consultation, fixed-price proposal in 7 business days, weekly written updates, one-year workmanship warranty.
- Contact: 443-761-9209, jon@precisionremodelingmd.com.

## Services

- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://precisionremodelingmd.com/kitchens.html): Custom kitchen remodels in NE Baltimore County, from focused $25,000 updates to full layout changes, fixed-price.
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://precisionremodelingmd.com/bathrooms.html): Primary, hall and guest bathroom renovations starting at $16,000, scope fixed before demolition.
- [Foundation & Structural Repair](https://precisionremodelingmd.com/structural-repairs.html): Foundation crack and bowing wall repair; $300 on-site assessment credited back to repair work.
- [$99 Property Walkthrough](https://precisionremodelingmd.com/walkthrough.html): Flat-fee visual walkthrough of a home by a licensed Maryland contractor, with a prioritized repair list.
- [$99 Investor Walkthrough](https://precisionremodelingmd.com/investor.html): Pre-offer walkthrough with repair scope and cost estimates for property investors.
- [Our Process](https://precisionremodelingmd.com/process.html): The four steps from consultation to final walkthrough.
- [Our Work](https://precisionremodelingmd.com/our-work.html): Portfolio of completed kitchen and bathroom projects.
